home.problemHeading: The Foundational Learning Challenge in Middle School
home.problemText: According to official national data from UDISE+ (2024-25) and ASER (2024), foundational arithmetic and reading gaps accumulated in early grades become acute barriers when students encounter abstract concepts in Classes 6 through 10. Without individualized diagnostic support, classroom instruction moves forward while learning gaps compound.
home.frameworkDesc: Built from the ground up on CBSE/NCERT curriculum standards for Mathematics, Science, English, and Social Science across grades 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10.

howItWorks.title: How BodhAI Works
howItWorks.subtitle: An evidence-based adaptive cycle engineered to diagnose prerequisites, bridge learning gaps, and build enduring conceptual mastery.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Micro-assessments determine prerequisite gaps from earlier grades rather than simply measuring test score outcomes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Targeted bilingual visual explanations illustrate core concepts in simple, accessible language with relatable Indian examples.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Scaffolded practice problems adjust difficulty dynamically using Bayesian knowledge tracing algorithms.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Low-stakes mastery checks confirm retention without inducing performance anxiety or exam fatigue.
howItWorks.step5Desc: The learning path re-calibrates in real time, serving remedial refreshers or accelerated challenges based on individual student mastery.

legal.draftNoticeBanner: DRAFT VERSION — This document is published for platform preview and transparency purposes. It is currently undergoing formal legal review under Indian statutory law (including the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000).
legal.privacySubtitle: Last updated: October 2026. Pending formal legal review.
legal.termsSubtitle: Last updated: October 2026. Pending formal legal review.
legal.privacyP1: 1. Scope & Application: This draft privacy policy describes how BodhAI processes learning telemetry for students in Classes 6 through 10 in India under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. Grievance Officer contact: grievance@bodhai.edu.in.
legal.privacyP2: 2. Data Inventory & Prohibited Data: We collect minimal account identifiers (email or username), guardian verifiable consent records, exercise telemetry (question response timestamps, accuracy, hint ladder usage), and Bayesian knowledge tracing mastery scores. We strictly NEVER collect Aadhaar numbers, biometric scans, financial/banking credentials, or precise GPS location.
legal.privacyP3: 3. Verifiable Parental Consent: For minors under 18, accounts require institutional school enrollment or verified guardian consent under Section 9 of the DPDP Act. The system actively enforces the current policy version (v2026.1); learning assessments are restricted if consent is revoked or outdated.
legal.privacyP4: 4. Storage Limitation & Automated Retention: All personal data is hosted within the Republic of India. Automated jobs prune AI tutor logs older than 90 days, clear processed sync queues after 30 days, purge expired sessions daily, and permanently scrub soft-deleted student accounts after a 30-day grace period.
legal.privacyP5: 5. Data Principal Rights: Students and guardians can exercise statutory rights anytime in Settings: export complete profile and learning telemetry in machine-readable JSON format, or request immediate PII erasure and profile anonymization.
legal.termsP1: BodhAI provides adaptive educational diagnostics and formative practice aligned with NCERT curriculum standards for Classes 6 through 10. Access is granted for non-commercial educational use in accredited schools and learning centers.
legal.termsP2: We uphold strict data minimization under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. Student accounts are identified solely by class roll numbers or pseudonyms. No advertising, cross-context behavioral tracking, or commercial monetization of student learning data is permitted.
legal.termsP3: Teachers and school administrators agree to maintain the confidentiality of school access codes and respect the intellectual property of curriculum content and diagnostic assessment items.
legal.legalReviewDisclaimer: MARKED FOR FORMAL STATUTORY LEGAL REVIEW UNDER THE DIGITAL PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION ACT, 2023.
